topic: Electric filing, tips, acrylic, and gel fundamentals
author: codex-authoring-run-2026-08-13-enhancements-01

why: Hold the electric file at about 30 degrees while shaping the enhancement. This lets the bit meet the surface without cutting straight into it.
塑形人工甲时，把电动磨甲机保持约 30 度。这样磨头能接触表面，而不会垂直切入产品。
lock: 30 degrees = shape the enhancement surface.
30 度 = 塑形人工甲表面。
refs: Electric Filing - Shaping an Enhancement

why: For shortening, the bit works across the nail's end instead of over the top surface. A 90-degree position keeps that cut straight.
修短时，磨头横向作用于指甲前端，而不是甲面。保持 90 度能让前端切口平直。
lock: 90 degrees = shorten the nail end.
90 度 = 修短指甲前端。
refs: Electric Filing - Shortening the Nails

why: A full-cover tip extends over the whole nail plate. It can create a smooth protective covering when a bitten nail has very little free edge.
全覆盖甲片会盖住整个甲板。被咬指甲几乎没有游离缘时，它能形成平整的保护性覆盖。
lock: full-cover tip = covers the whole nail plate.
全覆盖甲片 = 覆盖整个甲板。
refs: Nail Tips - Full-Coverage Tips

why: LED-curable gel contains ingredients that react to LED light. The correct lamp starts the hardening reaction in each gel layer.
可用 LED 固化的凝胶含有对 LED 光反应的成分。正确的灯会启动每层凝胶的硬化反应。
lock: LED-curable gel hardens under the matching LED lamp.
LED 凝胶要在匹配的 LED 灯下硬化。
refs: UV and LED Gels - Light Curing

why: A balanced enhancement has a smooth curve and enough support in the stress area. Poor balance can look uneven and can break more easily.
结构平衡的人工甲有平顺曲线，受力区也有足够支撑。结构不平衡会显得不均匀，也更容易断裂。
lock: good balance = even shape plus stress-area support.
良好结构 = 形状均匀，受力区有支撑。
refs: Electric Filing - Properly Structured Nails

why: Acetone softens many liquid-and-powder enhancements. Continued soaking lets the product release without prying or scraping the natural nail.
丙酮能软化许多液粉人工甲产品。持续浸泡可让产品脱离，不必撬刮天然指甲。
lock: acrylic removal = soak; never pry.
丙烯酸人工甲卸除 = 浸泡，不要硬撬。
refs: Monomer Liquid and Polymer Powder - Removal

why: Builder gel stays in place well enough to create shape and height. It can build a curved structure instead of only adding color.
builder gel（建构胶）能保持形状，用来建立高度和弧度，而不只是增加颜色。
lock: builder gel = build shape and strength.
builder gel = 建立形状和强度。
refs: UV and LED Gels - Building Gels

why: Product touching skin cannot bond correctly to the nail plate. As the skin moves and sheds, it pulls the attached product up and causes lifting.
碰到皮肤的产品不能正确黏附甲板。皮肤活动和脱落时，会把相连的产品拉起，造成翘起。
lock: product on skin = lifting risk.
产品碰到皮肤 = 容易翘起。
refs: Nail Product Chemistry - Avoiding Skin Contact

why: Some cured gels leave a sticky surface layer because air stops the top from curing fully. Alcohol removes that layer after curing is complete.
有些凝胶固化后会留下黏层，因为空气会阻碍最上层完全固化。完成固化后可用酒精擦去黏层。
lock: after gel curing: wipe the sticky layer with alcohol.
凝胶固化后：用酒精擦去黏层。
refs: UV and LED Gels - Removing the Inhibition Layer

why: As the natural nail grows, an empty area appears near the base. A fill places new product in that growth area and restores the structure.
天然指甲生长后，甲根附近会出现空出的新生区。fill（补甲）会在该区域加入新产品，恢复人工甲结构。
lock: fill = add product at new growth.
fill = 在新生区补加产品。
refs: Nail Enhancement Maintenance - Fills

why: Gel preparation and alcohol can dry the skin around the nail. Applying oil at the end replaces surface oil and softens that skin.
凝胶准备步骤和酒精可能使甲周皮肤干燥。最后涂油能补充表面油分并软化皮肤。
lock: after the sticky layer is removed: apply cuticle oil.
擦去黏层后：涂甲缘油。
refs: UV and LED Gels - Post-Service

why: Nail adhesive hardens quickly when it meets moisture on the nail. Use only a small amount because excess adhesive can spread onto skin.
美甲胶接触甲面水分后会快速硬化。只需少量使用，过多可能流到皮肤上。
lock: nail adhesive = small amount, fast hardening.
美甲胶 = 少量使用，快速硬化。
refs: Nail Product Chemistry - Nail Adhesives

why: In a liquid-and-powder system, monomer is the liquid part. It wets the polymer powder so the two can form a workable bead.
在液粉系统中，monomer（单体）是液体部分。它润湿 polymer 粉末，使两者形成可操作的小球。
lock: acrylic liquid = monomer.
丙烯酸液体 = monomer。
refs: Monomer Liquid and Polymer Powder - Product Chemistry

why: If acrylic is still firm, it needs more acetone time. Pushing or prying before it softens can pull layers from the natural nail.
如果丙烯酸产品仍然坚硬，就需要继续用丙酮浸泡。未软化前推刮或硬撬，会带走天然甲板层。
lock: still hard = keep soaking, never force removal.
仍然坚硬 = 继续浸泡，不要强行卸除。
refs: Monomer Liquid and Polymer Powder - Removal

why: Nitrocellulose stays behind as a smooth film after polish solvents evaporate. This film holds the color on the nail.
甲油溶剂蒸发后，nitrocellulose（硝化纤维素）会留下平滑薄膜，把颜色固定在指甲上。
lock: nail polish film former = nitrocellulose.
甲油成膜材料 = 硝化纤维素。
refs: Nail Product Chemistry - Nail Polish

why: Gel polish adds long-wearing color while keeping the natural nail's own shape. It is a coating, not a product built into a long extension.
gel polish（凝胶甲油）能在保留天然指甲形状的同时提供持久颜色。它是涂层，不是用来建构长延长甲的产品。
lock: gel polish = lasting color on the natural nail.
gel polish = 天然指甲上的持久颜色。
refs: UV and LED Gels - Gel Polish

why: Oil, water, and dust block product from touching the nail plate. A clean, dry surface gives the product direct contact and a stronger bond.
油、水和粉尘会挡住产品接触甲板。清洁、干燥的表面能让产品直接接触并黏得更牢。
lock: a better bond starts with a clean, dry nail.
更牢黏附从清洁、干燥的指甲开始。
refs: Nail Product Chemistry - Preparing for Adhesion

why: Keeping the bit flat and moving spreads pressure over the product surface. Tilting one edge into the nail can cut a visible ring.
让磨头平贴并持续移动，可把压力分散在产品表面。把一侧斜压进指甲会磨出明显环沟。
lock: avoid fire rings: bit flat, light pressure, keep moving.
避免火圈：磨头平贴、轻压、持续移动。
refs: Electric Filing - Avoiding Rings of Fire

why: A correctly cured gel may still feel sticky because of its top surface layer. Alcohol wipes away this layer without removing the hardened gel below.
正确固化的凝胶仍可能因表面黏层而发黏。酒精可擦掉这层黏层，而不会卸掉下面已硬化的凝胶。
lock: cured but sticky = wipe the surface layer with alcohol.
已固化但发黏 = 用酒精擦表面黏层。
refs: UV and LED Gels - Removing the Inhibition Layer

why: Finished acrylic is made of long polymer chains created during hardening. The liquid monomer and powder system becomes a solid polymer coating.
完成固化的丙烯酸人工甲由长聚合物链组成。液体单体和粉末系统会变成固体聚合物涂层。
lock: finished acrylic = hardened polymer.
完成的丙烯酸人工甲 = 已硬化聚合物。
refs: Nail Product Chemistry - Polymerization

why: Monomer liquid combines with polymer powder to make an acrylic bead. The bead then hardens through polymerization.
monomer 液体与 polymer 粉末结合形成丙烯酸小球，随后通过聚合反应硬化。
lock: liquid acrylic part = monomer.
丙烯酸液体部分 = monomer。
refs: Monomer Liquid and Polymer Powder - Product Chemistry

why: A correctly sized tip reaches from one nail sidewall to the other without pressing the skin. A tip that is too small can crack or lift.
尺寸正确的甲片应从一侧甲沟覆盖到另一侧，又不压皮肤。甲片太小会受力，容易裂开或翘起。
lock: tip width = sidewall to sidewall.
甲片宽度 = 从一侧甲沟到另一侧。
refs: Nail Tips - Proper Sizing

why: The stress area carries the most force where the free edge meets the nail bed. Proper thickness there helps prevent cracking.
stress area（受力区）位于游离缘与甲床交界处，承受的力量最大。这里厚度正确可帮助防止断裂。
lock: strength check = stress area.
强度检查 = 受力区。
refs: Nail Enhancement Structure - Stress Area

why: Hardened acrylic makes a light clicking sound when tapped. The brush handle tests the surface without pressing a finger into soft product.
硬化的丙烯酸产品轻敲时会发出清脆声。用刷柄测试，不会像手指那样压进未硬化产品。
lock: test acrylic hardness with a light brush-handle tap.
用刷柄轻敲测试丙烯酸是否硬化。
refs: Monomer Liquid and Polymer Powder - Testing the Cure

why: Acrylic touching the cuticle or skin cannot stay bonded to the nail plate. Skin movement lifts that product edge and lets water enter.
丙烯酸产品碰到甲小皮或皮肤后，无法持续黏附甲板。皮肤活动会抬起产品边缘，也可能让水进入。
lock: leave a small product gap around living skin.
产品与活皮肤之间要留小间隙。
refs: Nail Product Chemistry - Avoiding Skin Contact

why: Gel that receives too little curing light stays weak inside even if the surface looks hard. That weak layer can crack or break.
凝胶接受的固化光不足时，即使表面看似坚硬，内部仍然薄弱，因此可能开裂或断裂。
lock: too little curing = weak gel that may crack.
固化不足 = 凝胶薄弱，可能开裂。
refs: UV and LED Gels - Proper Curing

why: Holding the handpiece parallel keeps the bit's working surface even with the nail. A steep angle puts too much pressure on one small area.
手柄与甲面保持平行，可让磨头工作面均匀接触。角度太陡会把过多压力集中在一个小区域。
lock: electric file = parallel, light, moving.
电动磨甲机 = 平行、轻压、移动。
refs: Electric Filing - Handpiece Position

why: A flat hand keeps wet gel polish centered on the nail. Tilting the hand lets the product flow toward the sidewalls and skin.
手放平可让未固化的凝胶甲油保持在甲面中央。手倾斜会让产品流向两侧甲沟和皮肤。
lock: gel polish application = keep the hand flat.
涂凝胶甲油 = 手保持平放。
refs: UV and LED Gels - Gel Polish Application

why: A synthetic brush keeps its shape while moving gel and does not absorb much product. Natural hair is better suited to some liquid systems.
合成刷在移动凝胶时能保持形状，也不会吸收太多产品。天然毛刷更适合某些液体系统。
lock: gel brush = synthetic bristles.
凝胶刷 = 合成刷毛。
refs: UV and LED Gels - Brushes

why: Product bonds best when it touches the nail plate directly. Oil, dust, or moisture between them creates a weak layer that can lift.
产品直接接触甲板时黏得最牢。中间有油、粉尘或水分会形成薄弱层，容易翘起。
lock: good bond starts with a clean nail surface.
牢固黏附从清洁甲面开始。
refs: Nail Product Chemistry - Preparing for Adhesion

notes: All candidates remain unreviewed. Twenty-two product-dependent, ambiguous, or unsafe legacy items were quarantined.
